title: The epipot package
text: main workhorse package epigenetic_potential() function, requires following data: pair count matrices scATAC-seq scRNA-seq sparse format. pair vectors cell type annotations matrices. pair vectors giving samples contained matrices. function perform preprocessing analysis steps: Alternatively, want fully control individual steps function, can implement analysis workflow using functions provided package, . Create aggregate matrix count matrix. Scale rows aggregate matrices contains Z-scores. Annotate peaks ATAC-seq data genes. Create merged matrix containing scRNA-seq scATAC-seq data. Create model frame model matrix. Create model matrix. Run limma. Parse limma results. steps, res contain data run epigenetic_potential() function. Finally, results shown volcano plot.
code: # not run res <- epigenetic_potential(   rna_counts = rna_data@assays$RNA@counts,   rna_cell_types = rna_data@meta.data$cells_short,   rna_samples = rna_data@meta.data$orig.ident,   atac_counts = atac_data@assays$peaks@counts,   atac_cell_types = atac_data@meta.data$cell_type,   atac_samples = atac_data@meta.data$orig.ident ) rna_mat_agg <- aggregate_count_matrix(   counts = rna_data@assays$RNA@counts,    cell_types = rna_data@meta.data$cells_short,   samples = rna_data@meta.data$orig.ident ) atac_mat_agg <- aggregate_count_matrix(   counts = atac_data@assays$peaks@counts,    cell_types = atac_data@meta.data$cell_type,   samples = atac_data@meta.data$orig.ident ) rna_mat_z <- scale_rows(rna_mat_agg) atac_mat_z <- scale_rows(atac_mat_agg) atac_mat_z_anno <- annotate_atac_peaks(atac_mat_z) #> >> Using Genome:  ... #> >> Using Genome:  ... #> >> Using Genome:  ... merged_mat <- merge_count_matrices(rna_mat_z, atac_mat_z_anno) sample_metadata <- create_model_frame(merged_mat) model <- model.matrix(   ~ 0 + cell / tech,   data = sample_metadata  ) fit <-   merged_mat |>   lmFit(model) |>    eBayes() #> Coefficients not estimable: cellairway_smooth_muscle:techATAC cellAT1_AT2_like:techATAC cellAT2_Club_like:techATAC cellbronchial_vessel:techATAC cellchondrocytes:techATAC celldendritic_cells:techATAC cellgoblet_cells:techATAC cellInterstitial_macrophages:techATAC cellmast_cells:techATAC cellmonocytes:techATAC cellPNECs:techATAC cellpulmonary_neuroendocrine:techATAC cellunclassified:techATAC cellvascular_smooth_muscle:techATAC cellveins:techATAC res <- parse_limma_results(fit) res_filtered <-    res |>    filter(!is.na(logFC))  plot(   res_filtered$logFC,    -log10(res_filtered$adj.P.Val),    pch = 19,    col = factor(res_filtered$cell) )
